_comments.LIVE_TOKEN: Bot User OAuth Token from Slack app settings (xoxb-...)
_comments.LIVE_SIGNING_SECRET: Signing Secret from Slack app settings
_comments.OPENAI_API_KEY: OpenAI API key for AI functionality (sk-...)
_comments.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: Optional: Anthropic Claude API key for claude-* model switching (sk-ant-...)
_comments.GEMINI_API_KEY: Optional: Google Gemini API key for Gemini-powered web search
_comments.SNOOZE_DAYS: Optional: days of the week when reminders are disabled
_comments.STARTUP_MESSAGE: Optional: set to 'true' or 'yes' to post a compact 'Sleuth has been updated to X from the Y branch' notice on startup and 'Sleuth is shutting down.' on shutdown. Off by default.
_comments.STARTUP_MESSAGE_INCLUDE_CHANGELOG: Optional: set to 'true' or 'yes' to opt into the verbose startup body — both the changelog excerpt AND the delayed GitHub Actions CI run follow-up (when GITHUB_ACTIONS_REPO is also configured). Requires STARTUP_MESSAGE to also be truthy. Off by default. Despite the name, this flag now gates both verbose extras.
_comments.NOTION_TOKEN: Optional: Notion API token for search integration (ntn_...)
_comments.GITHUB_PAT: Optional: GitHub personal access token for issue status sync
_comments.GITHUB_USER_MAP: Optional: JSON object (as a string) mapping Slack user IDs to GitHub usernames, e.g. {"U000EXAMPLE1": "octo-dev"}. Used by the show-me command for GitHub activity enrichment. Requires GITHUB_PAT.
_comments.GITHUB_ACTIONS_REPO: Optional: owner/repo used to append the latest GitHub Actions run summary to startup messages
_comments.GITHUB_ACTIONS_WORKFLOW: Optional: workflow file name or workflow ID used to scope the startup Actions summary
_comments.GITHUB_ACTIONS_BRANCH: Optional: branch override for the startup Actions summary; defaults to Sleuth's current git branch
_comments.GITHUB_SYNC_HEARTBEAT_ENABLED: Optional: set to 'true' or 'yes' to post GitHub sync heartbeat messages in the reminder channel after each poll cycle
_comments.WPDBTK_RAG_ENABLED: Optional: set to 'true' or 'yes' to enable the admin-only ask-woo command for this workspace
_comments.WPDBTK_RAG_BASE_URL: Optional: base URL for the WP DB Toolkit RAG service
_comments.WPDBTK_RAG_SERVICE_TOKEN: Optional: bearer token Sleuth should use when calling the WP DB Toolkit RAG service
_comments.WPDBTK_RAG_DEFAULT_SOURCE: Optional: default source value sent with ask-woo requests when the feature is enabled
